name: recipe_job_alerts
description: Autonomy recipe: watches Gmail for job alerts or interview emails matching your keywords. Use for 'watch my email for job alerts', 'tell me when a job email comes in'.
instructions: 1. Ask which job titles or companies to watch for (e.g. 'data analyst, remote') unless they said. 2. Call background_agents with action 'create', name 'Job alerts', trigger_type 'mail_match', trigger_config {"query": "(<their keywords joined with OR>) (job OR interview OR application OR role) newer_than:2d"}, steps [{"tool": "create_reminder", "input": {"text": "Job email from {sender}: {subject}", "due_in_minutes": 5}}], max_runs_per_day 15. 3. After creating it, immediately call background_agents with action 'disable' and the same name, so it starts switched OFF. Tell the user: it's set up but off; they can test it once from Toolbox -> Background agents (Run) and switch it on there when happy. Changing agents only works from the PC, so if this was asked from the phone, say that and stop. This recipe only creates reminders; it never applies, replies or opens links.
